description: Security-relevant directive allowlist of suderra-agent.service (ADR-048 DEC-1.5, DEC-1.8, DEC-1.9, DEC-4.5, DEC-4.10, DEC-4.11, DEC-6, DEC-7.4, DEC-11.2, DEC-19, DEC-21). Units are parsed into (section, key, values) by the parsing rules below and compared as sets, never as text: comments, whitespace and the order of different keys do not matter, while the order of the values of an ordered key does. A key outside exact, required, present, allowed and the profile keys is a violation (reported as forbidden when a key-level forbidden rule names it). exact: the values must equal the list (as a sequence for ordered keys; an empty list means no value, and with present an explicit empty assignment). required: the values must contain the list. present: the key must appear. forbidden: a matching key, or key and value_pattern, is a violation. reset: see parsing.reset_rule. Violations are reported as <category>:<Section>.<Key> with category exact, required, present, forbidden, unknown, dropin or reset. The Suderra OS overlay unit plus its board drop-in, the generic-Linux reference unit and the cloud-generated fleet unit are all checked against this file.

parsing.rule: Each non-empty assignment of a key adds values. For list_keys the value is split on ASCII whitespace into separate values; for every other key the whole trimmed value is one value. ordered_keys keep the order of their values, because systemd runs ExecStartPre= and ExecReload= commands in order and lets the first SystemCallFilter= line decide between allow-list and deny-list mode. A board drop-in is parsed the same way and applies after the base unit.
parsing.reset_rule: An empty assignment (KEY= with nothing after the equals sign) resets every value accumulated for KEY so far and adds none, as systemd does for list and non-list settings alike (an empty SystemCallFilter= drops the seccomp filter, an empty RestrictAddressFamilies= allows every family, an empty ProtectSystem= restores the default). The keys in empty_value_keys are the exception: their empty assignment is itself the value (CapabilityBoundingSet= is the empty bounding set). Resetting a key named in exact, required, present or a profile's exact block is a violation reported as reset:<Section>.<Key>, even when values are assigned again afterwards; so is any empty assignment in a board drop-in. Resetting an allowed key only clears it.

forbidden.reason: A firewall or time-sync failure must not stop local control: ordering uses After=/Wants= only (DEC-7.4, DEC-11.2).
Same as Requires= (DEC-6.2).
The network never gates agent start or READY: safe state and local control come before any network (DEC-6.2).
Wants= would pull in network-online.target and, with the ordering it implies, delay start until the network is up or wait-online times out (DEC-6.2).
Same as Requires= (DEC-6.2).
Agent failures never escalate to an OS reboot, which would cut ventilation and pump outputs (DEC-6.5).
Same as FailureAction= (DEC-6.5).
Same as FailureAction= (DEC-6.5).
A missing release must fail verify-current loudly, not turn into a silent condition failure (DEC-1.4, DEC-1.5).
The agent runs with no capabilities; nothing binds below 1024 (DEC-1.8).
The hardware watchdog belongs to PID1 alone (DEC-6.6).
No TPM device in contract 1.x: /dev/tpm0 is never granted and /dev/tpmrm0 arrives only with the P2 TPM keystore through a board drop-in (DEC-21).
Device classes that cover the watchdog or the TPM (DEC-6.6, DEC-21).
Block devices and raw memory are never part of field I/O (DEC-1.8).
The agent manages no cgroups.
The only privileged hooks are the ExecStartPre=+ and ExecReload=+ edge verify-current calls (hooks, DEC-1.5, DEC-4.10).
The only privileged hooks are the ExecStartPre=+ and ExecReload=+ edge verify-current calls (hooks, DEC-1.5, DEC-4.10).
The only privileged hooks are the ExecStartPre=+ and ExecReload=+ edge verify-current calls (hooks, DEC-1.5, DEC-4.10).
Paths and security modes are compile-time constants in the suderra-os profile; no environment variable selects them (DEC-4.5, DEC-19).
Same as Environment= (DEC-19).

board_dropins.rule: A drop-in may set only the keys listed for its board, under [Service]; its values are added to the base unit's values and the union must equal base + drop-in exactly.

verify_current.runs_as: root, through the + prefix of ExecStartPre= and ExecReload= in the suderra-os profile
verifies: current is the rename(2)-installed link to the release the install receipt records (DEC-1.4, DEC-1.5)
the suderra-agent binary has the sha256 of the receipt and of the release statement's binary_digest (DEC-1.5)
the installed release statement, trust-anchors bundle, site config and RBAC manifest re-verify (statements.json reverification)
every file under /var/lib/suderra-site has the digest and size the install receipt records, and no other file is there (DEC-4.10)
verify_current.on_failure: The start or the reload is refused and a verify-current result with outcome rejected is written (result.schema.json, DEC-27).

reload.rule: systemd runs ExecReload= commands in order and stops at the first failure, so the agent receives SIGHUP only after root has verified the site files it will reload (DEC-4.10, DEC-4.12).
